Odysseus: Odysseus spent ten long years sailing home after the war ended.
战争结束后,奥德修斯花了十年漫长的时光航行回家。
Trojan: The Trojan soldiers hid inside a huge wooden horse at night.
特洛伊士兵夜里藏在一匹巨大的木马里面。
Ithaca: Ithaca was the small island that Odysseus called his true home.
伊萨卡岛是奥德修斯称之为真正家园的小岛。
Telemachus: Telemachus grew up without his father and set out to find him.
忒勒玛科斯在没有父亲的环境下长大,后来动身去寻找他。
Penelope: Penelope waited faithfully for her husband for twenty long years.
珀涅罗珀忠实地等待了她的丈夫整整二十年。
statesmanlike: The old professor gave some statesmanlike advice during the heated debate.
在激烈的辩论中,这位老教授提出了一些有政治家风范的建议。
Cyclops: The Cyclops trapped the sailors in his cave and blocked the door with a rock.
独眼巨人把水手们困在山洞里,并用一块巨石堵住了洞口。
merciful: The judge was merciful and gave the young man a second chance.
法官很仁慈,给了那个年轻人第二次机会。
at the crack of dawn: We left the camp at the crack of dawn to avoid the midday heat.
我们一大清早就离开营地,以避开中午的炎热。
quick as a flash: Quick as a flash, the cat caught the mouse before it could run.
那只猫一刹那间就抓住了老鼠,让它来不及逃跑。
a wolf in sheep’s clothing: Be careful of him; he is a wolf in sheep’s clothing.
小心他,他是一只披着羊皮的狼。
dead to the world: After the long trip, the boy was dead to the world in his bed.
长途旅行之后,男孩躺在床上睡得沉沉的。
belly: The bear’s belly grew round and fat before winter came.
冬天来临之前,那头熊的肚子变得又圆又胖。
Circe: Circe used her magic to turn the sailors into pigs.
瑟茜用魔法把水手们变成了猪。
wear off: The effect of the medicine will slowly wear off after a few hours.
药物的效果几小时后会慢慢消失。
Theseus: Theseus found his way out of the maze using a simple ball of thread.
忒修斯用一个简单的线团找到了走出迷宫的路。
transparently: He transparently tried to hide his mistake, but everyone saw it.
他显然想掩盖自己的错误,但大家都看见了。
zoom in on: The camera slowly zoomed in on the child’s smiling face.
镜头慢慢拉近,聚焦在孩子微笑的脸上。
Sinis: Travelers feared Sinis, who attacked people near the narrow road.
旅客们害怕西尼斯,他在狭窄的道路附近袭击行人。
Procrustes: In the old story, Procrustes forced every guest to fit his iron bed.
在古老的故事里,普罗克拉斯提斯强迫每位客人适合他的铁床。
Crete: Crete is a large island in the sea south of Greece.
克里特岛是希腊以南海域中的一座大岛。
fleece: The farmer sheared the soft fleece from his sheep in spring.
农民在春天剪下绵羊身上柔软的羊毛。
Perseus: Perseus bravely faced the snake-haired monster and won the fight.
珀尔休斯勇敢地面对那个长着蛇发的怪物并赢得了战斗。
(be) faced with: She was faced with a difficult choice between her job and her family.
她面临在工作与家庭之间做出艰难选择的处境。
in disbelief: He stared at the winning ticket in disbelief for a whole minute.
他难以置信地盯着那张中奖彩票看了整整一分钟。
drop into: We decided to drop into the new bookshop on our way home.
我们决定回家路上顺便进那家新书店看看。
unsettling: The strange phone call in the middle of the night was deeply unsettling.
半夜那通奇怪的电话让人深感不安。
dozens of: Dozens of students gathered outside the library before it opened.
图书馆开门前,几十名学生聚集在门外。
now and again: Now and again, I call my old teacher just to say hello.
我偶尔会给老教师打个电话,只是为了问声好。
expectantly: The dog sat by the door, watching us expectantly for a walk.
狗坐在门边,满怀期待地看着我们,等着去散步。
co-operate: The two classes will co-operate with each other on the school play.
两个班将在学校话剧上互相合作。
pleasureable: We spent a pleasureable afternoon walking along the quiet river bank.
我们沿着安静的河岸散步,度过了一个愉快的下午。
algebra: She finds algebra hard, but she practices it every evening.
她觉得代数很难,但她每天晚上都练习。
agro-scientifc: The new agro-scientifc methods helped the village grow more rice.
新的农业科学方法帮助这个村庄种出了更多水稻。
drop in: Please drop in for a cup of tea whenever you are nearby.
无论你什么时候在附近,请顺便进来喝杯茶。
call on: We plan to call on our grandparents this coming weekend.
我们打算这个周末去拜访爷爷奶奶。
stewardess: The stewardess kindly brought a blanket to the tired passenger.
女乘务员好心地给疲惫的乘客拿来了一条毯子。
bishop: The bishop visited our small town to lead the Sunday service.
主教来到我们的小镇主持星期天的礼拜。
go on circuit: The judge will go on circuit to hear cases in smaller towns.
这位法官将进行巡回审判,在较小的城镇审理案件。
shaver: Dad bought a new electric shaver before his business trip.
爸爸在出差前买了一把新的电动剃须刀。
